groups.reason: Independent reviewed naming evidence, not shared spelling: Bugyi/Kellermayer historical research ties the 1942 protein name to its effect on myosin activity; Merriam-Webster separates the protein noun, tentatively deriving it from act/activate, from the Greek ray combining form. On this documented naming evidence this protein sense is admitted to act for the three frozen corpus IDs only. F-actin is the filamentous form; actin-binding explicitly names the same protein component. No automatic actin- reflex or protein taxonomy promotion.
